#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <bitset>
#include <algorithm>

int countUnique(int a, int b, int l, int r);

std::string buildString(int a, int b, int l) {
    std::string sb;
    for (int i = 0; i < a; ++i) {
        sb.push_back('a' + i);
    }
    char fill;
    if (l < a) {
        fill = sb[a - 1];
    } else {
        fill = sb[(b < a) ? b : a - 1];
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < b; ++i) {
        sb.push_back(fill);
    }
    std::bitset<30> used;
    for (int i = 0; i < a; ++i) {
        used.set(sb[sb.length() - 1 - i] - 'a');
    }
    int ptr = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < a; ++i) {
        while (used.test(ptr)) {
            ++ptr;
        }
        sb.push_back('a' + ptr);
        used.set(ptr);
    }
    fill = sb[std::min(b, a - 1) + a + b];
    for (int i = 0; i < b; ++i) {
        sb.push_back(fill);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < a + b; ++i) {
        sb.push_back(sb[i]);
    }
    return sb;
}

int countUnique(int a, int b, int l, int r) {
    std::string s = buildString(a, b, l);
    std::bitset<30> seen;
    for (int i = l; i <= r; ++i) {
        seen.set(s[i] - 'a');
    }
    return seen.count();
}

int main() {
    int a, b, left, right;
    std::cin >> a >> b >> left >> right;
    left--;
    right--;
    int len = a + b;
    int ans;
    if (right - left >= 2 * len) {
        ans = std::max(a + 1, 2 * a - b);
    } else {
        right -= len * (left / len);
        left %= len;
        ans = countUnique(a, b, left, right);
    }
    std::cout << ans << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
